topic: Weekly raid group coordinating boss strategy in a gaming server.

lead.author: Ren
lead.text: Sorry, I'm trying, can we just move on please.

topic: Weekly raid group coordinating boss strategy in a gaming server.

closing.author: Sam

topic: Design team channel reviewing a shared mockup file.

topic: Design team channel reviewing a shared mockup file.
